* fix: Use commit SHA as image tag to force Cloud Run updates

When deploying with Terraform, using :latest tag doesn't trigger updates
when container content changes. This fix:

- Adds image_tag variable to Terraform (defaults to "latest")
- Updates all Cloud Run service images to use ${var.image_tag}
- Passes github.sha as image_tag from the workflow

This ensures Cloud Run services are updated on every deployment.
